Challenge.title: Challenge
Challenge.description: A 30-day habit consistency challenge owned by a user.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this challenge.

subtitle.description: Short commitment statement or goal description.

startDate.description: ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD when the 30-day challenge starts.

targetDays.description: Total days in the challenge (fixed at 30).

habits.description: Bounded list of up to 8 serialized habit definitions (id|title|unit|target).

completedDays.description: Bounded list of completed day numbers (1-30).

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily push reminders are enabled for this challenge.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the challenge was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the challenge was last updated.

HabitLog.title: HabitLog
HabitLog.description: Daily habit completion and reflection log for a specific day (1-30) of a challenge.

dayNumber.description: Day index within the 30-day cycle (1 to 30).

dateStr.description: ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD for this log.

completedHabitIds.description: Bounded list of completed habit IDs for this day.

reflectionNote.description: Daily journal reflection or consistency note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the log was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the log was last updated.

NotificationPreference.title: NotificationPreference
NotificationPreference.description: User push notification and daily motivational quote delivery settings.

pushEnabled.description: Whether browser push notifications are enabled.

morningQuoteTime.description: 24-hour HH:MM schedule for the daily motivational quote notification.

eveningCheckinTime.description: 24-hour HH:MM schedule for the evening habit log reminder.

soundEnabled.description: Whether subtle chime audio plays with in-app reminders.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were last updated.

/challenges/{challengeId}.description: Top-level collection storing 30-day challenges owned by authenticated users.

/challenges/{challengeId}/logs/{logId}.description: Subcollection storing daily habit logs and reflections for a specific challenge.

/notificationPreferences/{userId}.description: User-keyed document storing push notification schedules and daily quote preferences.
